policy: sign(feature); zero feature means zero exposure
fitting: NONE; all eligible sessions evaluated once; no parameter selection
availability: bar start + 30 minutes ASSUMED, not measured; historical revised aggregates
exclusions: weekends, missing exact 09:30 or 15:30 ET bar, invalid/nonfinite OHLCV, duplicate timestamps rejected
primary: mean policy signed target minus always-long target, basis points
uncertainty: circular moving block bootstrap of paired daily differences, block 5 eligible sessions, 10000 resamples, seed 74001, percentile 95% interval
cost_scope: illustrative round-trip deductions from signed log-return; not executed returns, no fill/borrow inference
promotion: NEVER from this diagnostic pilot; quotes, independent holdout and execution validation required
power: At 100 independent sessions, approximate 80% power at two-sided 5% requires standardized mean difference 0.28. Serial dependence increases this threshold. No small-edge power claim.
prior_exposure: Known project experiments used June-September 2026; no claim that this historical range is globally unseen by researchers or published literature.
provider: Massive unadjusted 30-minute historical aggregates; exact windows required
bounds: No optimizer, no policy changes after outcomes, no market orders, no account PnL
